paite: Manasseh in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Manasseh / (2 Kum 21.1-9)
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou, Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak Pathian thei lou namte'n thilkihhuaitak ahih bang uh ama'n leng ahih zel hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Apa Hezekiah in ahihchip nung mun sangte abawlhoih a, Baalte a ding in maitam abawl a, Asherah limte abawl a, van a om tengteng abia a, a-nna uh asem hi.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he raised up altars for the Baals, made Asheroth, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

paite: "Jerusalem ah tangtawn in ka min a-om ding," TOUPA'N achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”

paite: TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Phaizang ah Hinnom tapa mei ah atate alutsak a; aisante aching a, bumte aching a, dawi aisan siam zawlte leh bumsiamte aguai sek a; TOUPA thangpaisak ding in amitmuh ah thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: Pathian in David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem a Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding, achih khitsa Pathian inn ah amah bawl, milim bawltawm akoih hi.
english: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

paite: Thu ka piak tengteng leh dan tengteng, dan thuseh, thilhih ding Mosi zang a ka piakte azuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a kipan Israelte khe ka kal suankhesak nawn kei ding," achihna ah.
english: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

paite: Manasseh in Judahte leh Jerusalem a mite thil ahihkhialsak a; TOUPA'N Israelte ma a ahihman khitsa namte sang in ahihkhialzaw hi.
english: Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they did more evil than did the nations whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Manasseh leh amite kiang ah thu agen zel a; himahleh alimsak kei uhi.
heading: Manasseh Akisik
english: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria sepaih heutute asawl a, Manasseh khainiang in akhih ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipihta uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

paite: Huchi in mangbangtak a a-om lai in TOUPA a Pathian azong a, api-le-pute Pathian ma ah nakpitak in akiniamkhiak hi.
english: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

paite: Akiang ah athum a, hehpih angen a, angetna angaihkhiaksak a, Jerusalem ah agam ah apai nawnta hi.
english: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh was God.

paite: Huai nung in David kho polam ah Gihon tumlam pang phaizang ah ngasa kongkhak lutna pha in kulh abawl a, Ophel umsuak in sangpi in adingsak a: Judah khua kulh nei tengteng ah heutu hangsan taktak akoih hi.
english: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.

paite: Gamdang pathiante leh milimte, TOUPA' inn a kipan apaimang a, tang a TOUPA' inn leh Jerusalem a maitam abawl tengteng khua a kipan apaikhe vek uhi.
english: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of Yahweh’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of Yahweh’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

paite: TOUPA maitam abawl a, lemna thillat kithoihnate, kipahthu gennate alan a, Judahte bel TOUPA Israel' Pathian nasem ding in thu apia hi.
english: He built up Yahweh’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Mipite mun sang ah akithoih lailai ua; himahleh TOUPA a Pathian uh kiang ah kithoih ahi zawta hi.
english: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.

paite: Manasseh tanchin dang tengteng, a Pathian kiang a athum thute, TOUPA Israel' Pathian min a zawlnei in akiang a thu agente uh ngai dih, Israel kumpipate tanchin lak ah atuang hi.
heading: Manasseh Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

paite: Athumnate, Pathian in ahehpihna leh akiniamkhiak ma in agitlouhna tengteng, mun sang abawl a, Asher leh milim bawltawm a bawlkhiakna mun tengteng leng, ngai dih, Hozai tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang vek hi.
english: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.

paite: Huchi in Manasseh bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, ama inn ah avui ua; atapa Ammon in asik in vai ahawmta hi.
english: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ammon in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum nih vai ahawm hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ammon
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

paite: Apa Manasseh hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; apa Manasseh in abawl milim bawltawm tengteng kiang ah Ammon akithoih a, a-nna asem hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

paite: Apa Manasseh kiniamkhiak bang in TOUPA ma ah akiniamkhiak kei a, Ammon agilou semsem hi.
english: He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.

paite: Huchi in a sikhate'n asawm ua, ama inn ah athat uhi.
english: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

paite: Himahleh kumpipa Ammon kalh a phialguk sawm mi tengteng mipi'n athat vek nawn ua; asik a kumpipa hi ding in mipite'n atapa Josiah abawlta uhi.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
